messages:
Jay Park: Heads-up: FinTrust asking for a POC that guarantees EU-only processing and zero analytics outside EU. They also want BYO-KMS (prefer GCP CMEK) and APAC only as an inactive DR target. Can presales confirm feasibility + quick pricing delta?

Iris Nguyen: Short answer: feasible but depends on hosted vs dedicated. Hosted can do envelope-wrapped CMEKs (customer supplies wrapped DEK). Direct CMEK API calls require Dedicated/Private. Also hosted telemetry currently uses an optional global aggregator unless opted out.

Omar Haddad: If they insist on "zero analytics outside EU" we need a subproc addendum + opt-out config. Otherwise recommend Dedicated EU-only which avoids non-EU subprocessors but adds provisioning time and cost.

Jay Park: Can you sketch a minimal routing policy I can paste to the customer? Also need an initial ballpark delta for a small POC (10k tokens/day).

Iris Nguyen: Routing policy snippet ready:
```
tenant: fintrust-poc
processing_region: eu-west-1
control_plane: eu-only (opt-out of global telemetry requested)
failover: apac-standby (manual activation only)
subprocessors_allowed: [aws-eu-west-1, redwood-monitoring-eu, redwood-cdn-eu]
```

Omar Haddad: Ballpark: hosted w/ envelope BYO -> baseline + ~15%-25% premium (for tenant pinning & support). Dedicated/Private (EU-only) -> baseline + ~30%-50% plus one-time onboarding $2k-$5k and 6-9 week lead. Exact numbers after RPS/tokens.

LegalBot: Required docs: signed DPA, subprocessor addendum, BYO-KMS attestation form, and telemetry opt-out acknowledgement. Provide full subproc list and egress diagram.

Jay Park: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) Iris confirm whether hosted can disable the aggregator for the tenant (full opt-out), 2) Omar to produce a concise one-pager with the price deltas and provisioning timelines. I'll loop in the customer after EOD.

Iris Nguyen: Confirmed: hosted has an opt-out toggle for aggregated telemetry; enabling opt-out reduces our visibility for that tenant (note in reply). We still retain 90-day operational logs for security/incident purposes.

Omar Haddad: I'll draft the one-pager and include a simple diagram showing control plane vs compute egress paths. ETA 6 hrs.

Jay Park: Thanks. I'll ask FinTrust to confirm which KMS provider (GCP CMEK vs AWS KMS) and expected tokens/day so we can firm the estimate. :thumbsup:
